name: Kaitei Gunkan
source:
Game's based on year 1963 Japanese film about submarine. It is divided in two parts: first you search for an enemy with command input and then action based underwater battle.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自1963年的日本电影《海底军舰》，游戏分为两部分：首先通过输入指令寻找敌人，随后进入以动作玩法为主的水下战斗。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
